items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: I’ve been touring with the Monk All- Stars lately, the last few years, Johnny Griffin and Phil Woods and Ben Riley.

ctx.x: Tell me a little bit more about recording with Thelonious Monk. Was it like other sessions you’ve done?

No. But we had a lot of rehearsal. We rehearsed quite a bit. And just those concerts, he never did a tour with the band or anything like that. I’ve been touring with the Monk All- Stars lately, the last few years, Johnny Griffin and Phil Woods and Ben Riley. And Monk never did that. I think he went to Europe one time. I didn’t go with him. Jimmy Cleveland went with him. But that’s about the only time that he used that big band other than the © Fillius Jazz Archive -20-
Lincoln Center and the Town Hall. I mean he did a Carnegie Hall but they never recorded that.
